schema.description: Where the rules, check results, quarantine and freshness tables live: 'schema' (foundation catalog) or 'catalog.schema'

rules.description: YAML file (relative to maya.yaml) with the customer's rules per table, freshness limits and rejected suggestions

layers.description: Foundation layers whose tables are monitored (tables named in the rules file are monitored too)

suggest.description: Let the dq_analyst agent suggest rules from each table's profile (the data owner approves them)

allow_data.description: Show sample values (top values, minimum, maximum) of non-sensitive columns to the model. Default: G1's allow_data

freshness_hours.description: Freshness limit per layer, in hours since the last data change. Default: G0's freshness_hours

sensitive.description: Column tag values (set by G1) never copied to the quarantine or shown to the model. Default: G4's sensitive setting

quarantine_rows.description: Failing rows kept per rule and check run (keys and non-sensitive columns only)

retention_days.description: Check results and quarantined rows older than this are deleted

cron.description: Quartz cron expression, for example '0 0 6 * * ?' (06:00 daily)

schedule.description: When the check job runs (the alerts are evaluated at the end of every run)

user.description: User name (email) of a workspace user

destination.description: Id of a notification destination (email list, Slack, Teams)

recipients.description: Who the alerts notify, and who hears when the check job fails

dashboard.description: The data quality dashboard (title default: '<project> data quality')

readers.description: Who may read the quality schema (SELECT) and open the dashboard (account-level groups or service principals)

mode.description: incremental: the agent only re-profiles tables that changed since certification

model.description: AI Gateway model for this goal's agent (default: the project's model)

reject.description: Ids of suggested rules the data owner turned down; never proposed again

expression.description: SQL condition every row must satisfy

to.description: references: 'schema.table.column' (or catalog-qualified) the column must match

tolerance.description: Fraction of rows that may fail before the rule fails
